novel.justification: This synchronized bandwidth regime is newly maintained for the nested two-dimensional functional: it balances the order-minus-two transport bias, the \(C^{2,1/4}\) pilot stability needed along the nonlinear interpolation, and the quadratic \(C^{1,1/4}\) remainder. Polynomial choices in this interval are implementable without oracle quantities, and for the maintained \(s\geq8\) class the interval is nonempty.
